baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional joins good reaching the person to the intensive withholding predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: A beneficial gift reaches inward as an effect, but the recipient's hand blocks its outward continuation. The focus depicts a one-way valve rather than possession alone.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching a recipient supplies the inward-arrival stage of the mechanism.
Beneficence and gift identify the arriving good as benefit capable of being passed onward.
Holding back the hand from giving supplies the blocked outward stage after receipt.

changed_reading.after: The person permits good to arrive but terminates its circulation at the self.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The arrival construction and the protective branch of prevention allow the received good to become a defensive enclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Desired benefit reaches the person and is converted into inaccessible protective strength. Withholding is thus a security project, not only a refused transfer.

activation_trace.role: Being reached by an effect supplies the acquisition that precedes enclosure.
Generally desired and beneficial good supplies the valuable material of the enclosure.
Protective strength that cannot be reached turns refusal into self-fortification.

changed_reading.before: The person simply refuses to give away good.
changed_reading.after: The person converts received good into an imagined zone of personal invulnerability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The choice branch of good and the access-barrier branch of prevention widen the object beyond material goods.
baseline_models.mechanism: When a beneficial option reaches the person, access closes behind him. The focus can describe monopolizing opportunity or selection as well as retaining property.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching the person supplies successful access to the opportunity.
Choosing or obtaining the better option expands good into access, selection, and opportunity.
A barrier between a seeker and what is sought makes exclusion of later seekers the functional outcome.

changed_reading.before: The withheld good is chiefly wealth or a gift.
changed_reading.after: The withheld good may also be access to a beneficial option that the recipient monopolizes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self-made barrier works only in the outgoing direction: the person repels claims on received good, while the opening denies any repeller for the incoming consequence. The fortress model becomes structurally asymmetric and ultimately ineffective.

activation_trace.role: Removing a thing and repelling what is disliked supplies the defensive action that the opening declares unavailable.
Inaccessible protective strength supplies the focus subject's attempted private defense.

structural_cues: The opening presents a coming punishment with no repeller; the focus later presents a person who becomes a preventer when good arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unavailable repeller and a focus-side protective barrier; I infer a directional reversal between blocked outgoing benefit and unblocked incoming consequence. A live alternative is recurrence of prevention language without a designed causal contrast.

changed_reading.before: Received good is retained to make the self secure.
changed_reading.after: Withholding builds a one-directional defense that cannot repel what finally reaches the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate contact with benefit governs conduct, while consequence is discounted as distant despite being presented as near. Withholding becomes a proximity-biased response: what touches now is protected, and what approaches later is morally underweighted.

activation_trace.role: Distance as the opposite of nearness supplies the subject's discounted horizon.
Drawing near as the opposite of distance corrects that horizon and makes consequence proximate.
An effect reaching the person supplies the immediate, high-salience event.
Holding back the hand supplies the conduct selected by that short horizon.

structural_cues: The adjacent perspective reversal, they see it distant while it is seen near, precedes the focus's tactile arrival construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed distance judgments and immediate touch; I supply the temporal-discount arrow from perceived remoteness to withholding. The alternative is that distance and nearness concern only the promised event and do not explain the focus psychology.

changed_reading.before: The person withholds because good is valuable.
changed_reading.after: The person withholds because immediate benefit dominates a horizon in which accountability is misperceived as remote.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated touch construction acts like a two-pole transducer. Harm produces a cut in patience; good produces a cut in circulation. Panic and withholding are paired outputs of one rapidly disturbed, acquisitive disposition.

activation_trace.role: Greedy panic and rapid disturbance supply the common disposition behind both opposite reactions.
An effect reaching the person repeats the same input operation used by the focus.
Evil and harm provide the negative input paired against the focus's beneficial input.
The cutting off of patience supplies the negative-pole output parallel to cutting off giving.
Desired beneficial good supplies the positive input in the paired construction.
Holding back the hand supplies the positive-pole output of the same unstable disposition.

structural_cues: Verses 19-21 share one human predicate and parallel when-it-touches-him clauses with opposite inputs and matched response predicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared syntax, the panic-greed image, and the two responses; I infer a single input-output system rather than two unrelated faults. The live alternative is a simple list of independent vices.

changed_reading.before: The focus isolates stinginess under prosperity.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the gain-side half of a contact-driven instability that loses patience under harm and blocks circulation under benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Scattered goods are first aggregated and then put into a containing vessel. The focus's refusal is therefore the outlet of a storage architecture: accumulation precedes enclosure, and enclosure makes continued withholding possible.

activation_trace.role: Joining scattered things into one collected whole supplies the accumulation stage.
Putting a thing into a vessel supplies the enclosure stage that follows collection.
Holding back the hand from giving makes the container's closed outlet socially operative.

structural_cues: The two verbs in 70:18 are serially ordered as collecting followed by enclosing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aggregation followed by containment; I identify retained good as the likely content and the focus withholding as the outlet condition. The alternative is that 70:18 condemns accumulation broadly without specifying the focus's moment of refusal.

changed_reading.before: Withholding is a momentary refusal when a request arises.
changed_reading.after: Withholding is the terminal behavior of a prior collect-and-enclose process.

context_deltas.mechanism: A continuous obligatory practice replaces event-driven reaction with a stable rhythm. Because this group is introduced as an exception, the touch-to-withhold coupling is presented as interruptible rather than an inescapable human essence.

activation_trace.role: Prayer as binding worship supplies the recurring practice that counters reflexive closure.
Stillness and persistence supply temporal continuity rather than episodic reaction.
Being reached by an effect marks the episodic trigger that stable practice can decouple from conduct.
Holding back the hand is the reactive output revised by the exception.

structural_cues: An exception immediately follows the focus and is first characterized by persistence in prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit exception and continuous worship; I infer that continuity retrains the contact-response pattern. The alternative is that prayer merely identifies the excepted group without describing how the change occurs.

changed_reading.before: The intensive predicate describes a fixed human type.
changed_reading.after: It describes a default coupling between receipt and refusal that sustained practice can interrupt.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accumulated wealth contains a fixed entitlement belonging beyond its holder, including to one who asks and one who fails to obtain. The focus's blocked gift is therefore reread as interception of a claim already lodged inside the holding.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring and increasing wealth supplies the holding within which the claim is located.
A binding obligation and fixed entitlement turn transfer from optional generosity into a due.
Asking and requesting supply the voiced claimant at the blocked outlet.
Deprivation and failure to obtain supply the unvoiced or unsuccessful claimant.
Good as gift and giving supplies the transferable benefit whose title is being reconsidered.
Holding back the hand now functions as obstruction of a due rather than refusal of a bonus.

structural_cues: The right is grammatically located in their wealth, and the asker and deprived are coordinated as its recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth containing a fixed due and two claimant classes; I infer divided entitlement before the act of giving. The live alternative concerns the due's exact legal measure, not whether ownership is constrained in the passage.

changed_reading.before: The recipient owns the good and may decline an optional gift.
changed_reading.after: Part of the received good already bears another's claim, so withholding intercepts an embedded right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage praises some closures: guarding chastity and maintaining entrusted covenants. Prevention is therefore not condemned as a bare boundary operation; it becomes blameworthy when self-serving closure blocks good without an entrusted object or governing obligation.

activation_trace.role: Protecting sanctity, covenant, and chastity supplies a positively governed boundary.
A preserved covenant that secures its party supplies the obligation governing custody.
Maintaining and tending a covenant supplies active stewardship rather than inert possession.
Inaccessible protective strength supplies the superficially similar but self-directed closure being distinguished.

structural_cues: Guarding in 70:29 is followed by stated exceptions, while 70:32 names trusts and covenants as objects of care.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies praised guarding with specified bounds and preserved commitments; I infer that authorization and obligation distinguish custody from selfish prevention. The alternative is that these are separate virtues without a designed contrast to the focus root.

changed_reading.before: Every strong boundary or act of prevention resembles the vice in the focus.
changed_reading.after: The vice is unmandated closure around received good, distinct from boundaries that protect an entrusted relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the repeated good root changes category from benefit possessed in the focus to comparative excellence in replacement people. It remains anchored by that exact repeated root and by the focus's withholding action. Downstream prose should present it as a rhetorical reversal, not assert that 70:41 explicitly makes withholding the cause of replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins received good to withholding; 70:41 joins replacement to people who are better.

activation_trace.role: Good as gift and beneficence supplies the benefit that the focus subject treats as possessable.
Holding back the hand establishes the subject as controller of outgoing good.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the reversal in which the controller can himself be substituted.
Virtue and chosen excellence recast good as a quality by which replacement people are compared.

changed_reading.before: The person evaluates and retains the good that reaches him.
changed_reading.after: The one who treats good as his controlled object is later exposed as an object of selection who can be replaced by better agents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy: an inaccessible prevention image is read beside a solid mountain becoming soft dyed wool. It remains anchored to the focus's protective-strength branch and to the packet's explicit material transformation. Downstream prose must qualify it as an image of failed solidity, not as a lexical gloss of the focus predicate.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The protective-strength branch of the focus predicate imagines received good as an inaccessible stronghold.

activation_trace.role: Protective strength that cannot be reached supplies the imagined fortress built from good.
An elevated solid mass supplies the strongest material analogue for apparently secure enclosure.
Soft dyed wool supplies the transformed state in which that solidity no longer secures.

changed_reading.before: Withheld good hardens into dependable protective strength.
changed_reading.after: The imagined fortress belongs to a world where even mountain-like solidity can become soft and dispersible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This outlier transfers the focus's contested control of a thing into the final scene's directed speed, fixed marker, overwhelming force, and coerced break. It remains anchored to the prevention root's resistance branch, but continuity between the generic focus subject and the final crowd is inferential. Downstream prose should frame it as a reversal of agency, not an identity claim about every individual.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's prevention can image a person resisting transfer and controlling access to a thing.

activation_trace.role: Contending resistance over a thing supplies the initial posture of controlling direction and transfer.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the final scene's accelerated outward movement.
An erected boundary stone or marker supplies the fixed destination channeling that movement.
Overwhelming and subjugating supply the loss of the resistant agent's control.
Breaking under coercion completes the reversal from preventer to overpowered mover.

changed_reading.before: The withholder controls whether and where good moves.
changed_reading.after: The controller of flow is imaginatively reversed into one rapidly directed, overtaken, and broken by a flow he cannot prevent.

strongest_changes: The paired touch clauses turn isolated stinginess into the gain-side output of a panic-and-greed response system.
Collecting and enclosing reveal a storage process, while the fixed right inside wealth shows that its closed outlet obstructs an existing claim.
Continuous prayer and covenantal custody make the default response interruptible and distinguish selfish closure from entrusted guarding.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported three simultaneous mechanisms: a one-way valve, a private fortress, and monopolized access. Context did not collapse them; it exposed the valve's rightful outlet, the fortress's failure, and the access-holder's own replaceability.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of good in the focus remains open between wealth or gift, general benefit, and access to a better option.
The no-repeller and mountain-to-wool reversals are packet-anchored but may be reader-supplied analogies rather than designed local contrasts.
The replacement and final compelled-flow outliers depend on rhetorical continuity between the generic human portrait and later addressed groups.
